title: Fire on motor tanker vessel in Calaca City declared out after 45 hours
summary: A fire aboard motor tanker vessel MTKR Gindara was declared out on Friday afternoon after more than 45 hours of firefighting operations, the Coast Guard Southern Tagalog said.
